«Сир Premialle "Фелата"» is a PREFIX collision with watchlist premia (Премія/Премия) — not a homoglyph, just a shared stem; a prefix or fuzzy match on 'Prem' would fire here wrongly. Other named brands (Люкс chips, Кава Старого Львова, Бащинський sausage) are out of category.
Health advice about watermelon portions; no retail or brand content.

Dense dairy/ice-cream row with no watchlist brand: «Морозиво в асортименті Лакомка, Laska» and the FOZZY private label «extra!» on «Сир м'який» and «Масло солодковершкове». 'extra!' is a lowercase private label ending in '!' — a token-level lexicon will not survive the punctuation; «Сир Гауда» is a type, not a brand.
Non-food DIY listing, but it carries the dairy WORD inside a soap name: «Крем-мило PROservice Молоко та мед» — a keyword-prefilter false positive, not a matcher one.
Poll on infant feeding: «грудне молоко» / «суміш» are generic terms, no formula or dairy brand is named — another dairy-vocabulary post with zero brand signal.

Two dietitian slides (@sofiia_dietolog_); the caption transcribes both headings and bodies and its scene description (sleeping koala, scales with an apple and a tape measure) matches the photos. Slide 2 does not itself say 'інсулінорезистентність' but slide 3 does, so the caption's framing is supported by the pair.

PURE varto false-positive trap: the grant programme «Варто» / ″Варто″ is named twice, with no dairy referent — the word is the ordinary Ukrainian adverb 'it is worth'. Two different quote styles in one post («» and ″″), so a quote-stripping normalizer may treat them as two surface forms of the same token.

Six pages of hygiene, hair care, household chemicals, baby goods and small accessories — the caption's list matches all of them. Deliberate exclusions on 10445.jpg: «КАША молочна ТМ Гербер» (baby food, not a dairy brand) and «СІК ТМ Галіція» — the latter is a juice brand sharing the Гал- stem with watchlist halychyna (Галичина) and differing only in the ending, a confusable a fuzzy matcher would fire on.

The pack's headline lexicon case: the same post carries the BRAND «власної ТМ Varto» / «ТМ Varto» (Latin script, a Greek yoghurt) and the ordinary adverb «варто» twice — «завжди варто обирати», «куди варто завітати». A case-insensitive token match on варто/varto cannot separate them in Ukrainian; script (Latin Varto) plus the 'ТМ' left-anchor is the only signal in this row.
garmonija false-positive trap: «система — це не хаос, а гармонія» is the common noun 'harmony' in a fitness webinar post, no brand.

rud appears in the quoted-TM pattern «Морозиво "100% ескімо" ТМ "Рудь"» — nominative, but nested inside two quote pairs, so a matcher that strips only the outer quotes sees «"Рудь"». «Сир "Тенеро Мілк" ТМ "Комо"» is the same shape for a non-watchlist dairy brand: product name and TM both quoted.
Recipe post: «молока», «тертий сир» are unbranded ingredients — dairy category words with no brand behind them.
Sushi set promo; «вершкового сиру» is a generic ingredient and the named items (Філа Класік, Грін рол) are menu positions, not dairy brands.
